I am passionate about human rights, protecting the environment and helping the less fortunate. I am a big fan of the arts, including theater, film, and music. In my free time, I enjoy hiking, cooking and spending time with my family. I hope to use my privilege to advance social justice and create a brighter future for generations to come. How much more, if anything, needs to be done to ensure equal rights for all Americans regardless of their racial or ethnic backgrounds?
 (A) A lot
 (B) Nothing at all
